columns.name: soil_type
columns.reason: Static site ground characteristic fixed long before any claim.

columns.name: grid_operator
columns.reason: Interconnection counterparty is a fixed site attribute.

columns.name: fuse_rating
columns.reason: As-built electrical spec of the string, known at commissioning.

columns.name: inverter_clip_hours
columns.reason: Accumulated operating telemetry observable up to the prediction point.

columns.name: inverter_model
columns.reason: Installed equipment model is fixed design data.

columns.name: cell_tech
columns.reason: Module cell technology is a fixed product attribute.

columns.name: el_image_crack_grade_fail
columns.reason: Electroluminescence crack grading is the diagnostic evidence used to adjudicate the warranty claim.

columns.name: snow_zone
columns.reason: Static climatic zoning of the site.

columns.name: cable_spec
columns.reason: As-built wiring specification known from design records.

columns.name: flood_class
columns.reason: Static site hazard classification.

columns.name: met_station
columns.reason: Identifier of the reference weather station assigned to the site.

columns.name: iv_curve_fill_factor_fail
columns.reason: IV-curve fill-factor failure is the qualifying performance test that determines claim eligibility.

columns.name: orientation_class
columns.reason: Fixed array design geometry.

columns.name: wind_zone
columns.reason: Static structural design zoning for the site.

columns.name: irradiance_mean
columns.reason: Historical meteorological aggregate measurable before prediction.

columns.name: tracker_flag
columns.reason: Fixed mounting design attribute.

columns.name: combiner_box
columns.reason: As-built electrical topology identifier.

columns.name: tilt_band
columns.reason: Fixed array tilt design attribute.

columns.name: security_class
columns.reason: Site security categorization set independently of any claim.

columns.name: module_replacement_count
columns.reason: Module swaps are the remedy delivered under the claim, so the count encodes the outcome.

columns.name: ppa_class
columns.reason: Offtake contract category fixed by agreement.

columns.name: epc_contractor
columns.reason: Construction contractor recorded at build time.

columns.name: monitoring_vendor
columns.reason: Monitoring platform vendor is a standing site attribute.

columns.name: string_length
columns.reason: Number of modules per string is fixed as-built design data.

columns.name: soiling_ratio_index
columns.reason: Routine soiling performance metric observed from operating history.

columns.name: insurer
columns.reason: Insurance counterparty on file before any claim event.

columns.name: module_vendor
columns.reason: Module manufacturer is fixed procurement data.

columns.name: truck_roll_cost_usd
columns.reason: Field service dispatch cost is incurred in responding to the failure, after the prediction point.

columns.name: shading_zone
columns.reason: Static site shading classification from layout analysis.

columns.name: land_lease_type
columns.reason: Land tenure arrangement fixed at project development.

columns.name: string_age_months
columns.reason: Elapsed service age is computable at the prediction point.

columns.name: om_contractor
columns.reason: Operations and maintenance provider is a standing contractual attribute.

columns.name: wash_contract
columns.reason: Module cleaning contract status is known in advance.

columns.name: site_code
columns.reason: Site identifier assigned at registration.

columns.name: module_temp_mean
columns.reason: Sensor-derived thermal aggregate from operating history before prediction.

columns.name: warranty_credit_usd
columns.reason: Credit issued under the warranty is the settlement of the claim itself.

columns.name: vegetation_plan
columns.reason: Groundskeeping plan established as part of site operations.

columns.name: commission_quarter
columns.reason: Commissioning date is historical and final.

columns.name: racking_type
columns.reason: Fixed mounting structure design attribute.

columns.name: post_repair_yield_ratio
columns.reason: Measured only after the repair that follows the claim, so it cannot exist at prediction time.
